انسجنا (form VII)
# اِنْسَجَنَا (insajanā) /in.sa.d͡ʒa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
# اِنْسَجَنَّا (insajannā) /in.sa.d͡ʒan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
# اِنْسَجِنَا (insajinā) /in.sa.d͡ʒi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
